description: Automated partner balance and COI calculations using n8n, reducing daily processing time from more than 2 hours to 10 minutes and eliminating 100% of manual workload for the operations team

Automated the partner reconciliation process by building a simple upload-based interface that preprocesses and compares transaction records, enabling the finance team to complete reconciliations for any month in around 5 seconds and clearing backlogs that had been pending for multiple months

Rebuilt internal data applications from R to Python, improving scalability and enabling better concurrency handling, which enhanced system performance and supported more efficient data processing at MoneyMatch
Assisted in networking tasks such as IP addressing, troubleshooting and network planning
Supported the team in implementing VLANs and subnetting strategies to optimize network segmentation and performance
